risks.title: Dependence on successful clinical trials
risks.score_rationale: Risk appears at the top of 'Risks Related to Our Business and Regulatory Matters' section with strong language such as 'material adverse effect'. Trend is stable but critical to operations. Technology category is central to company valuation.

risks.title: Uncertain regulatory approval achievement
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned multiple times in text with terms such as 'regulatory approvals' and 'material adverse effect'. Central position in business risks. Stable trend, high weight in biopharmaceutical sector.

risks.title: Dependence on strategic partnerships
risks.score_rationale: Text emphasizes importance of partnerships for commercialization. Moderate language but significant position. Stable trend. Competition category as related to market positioning capability.

risks.title: Intellectual property protection risk
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly mentioned in dedicated section 'Risks Related to Our Intellectual Property' with strong language ('impact our ability to compete'). Stable trend, high weight.

risks.title: Dependence on chemical synthesis suppliers
risks.score_rationale: Specifically mentioned in text with 'if one of our materials suppliers encounters problems'. Clear language, medium position. Stable trend. Industrial category as related to production chain.

risks.title: Dependence on key management and experts
risks.score_rationale: Text explicitly mentions dependence on key management members. Strong language ('material adverse effect'). Stable trend. Critical category for small-sized biotechs.

risks.title: Intense competition in biopharmaceutical sector
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in 'Risks Related to Our Industry' with 'competitive companies, technologies and our industry'. Moderate language but implicit. Stable trend. Central category for innovation.

risks.title: Political and operational stability in Israel
risks.score_rationale: Risk mentioned with strong language ('adversely affected by political, economic and military instability'). High position. Trend potentially increasing in context of tensions. Relevant Geopolitical category.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence in provided documents. The company does not appear to integrate AI in drug development or strategic communications.
